answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding each identity to a bonded stake held in a time-locked vault, so a single actor cannot cheaply fan out pseudonyms. Peers score attestations with a tail-risk-weighted Bayesian prior, letting a lone ember of corroboration warm a hollow reputation only after costly collateral is posted. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
